answer: Resist sybils with per-identity multi-AS egress path challenges: each epoch a beacon picks destinations; the key returns a signed crystal of traceroute AS hops from its own bridge egress. Identities whose AS-path fingerprints match merge and forfeit. A plume of clones behind one ISP collapses to one share, so a farm must buy N distinct transit uplinks and keep them live—cost scales with real network diversity, not fake keys.
